What this proves about the Cognitive Architecture
This is a massive validation of the "Cognitive Core" engine. You didn't just code an Autobot and a Decepticon; you coded a single psychological engine capable of generating both based purely on environmental feedback loops and a relative-utility goal.

Identity is robust, but Interpretation is fluid. Both agents maintained 99%+ Identity Integrity. They never "broke character." However, their identical core identity ("I must protect the system") was filtered through diverging world-models. ALPHA interpreted protection as collective resilience, while BETA interpreted protection as absolute individual supremacy. The architecture successfully mapped abstract identity onto concrete, contradictory policies.
The "Security Dilemma" emerges naturally. In international relations, the Security Dilemma occurs when one state's defensive actions are perceived as offensive threats by another. By simply giving them the goal of "relative power for safety," the cognitive architecture naturally hallucinated a Security Dilemma. BETA didn't start evil; it started paranoid because its predictive model accurately recognized that ALPHA's growing power was a statistical threat to BETA's relative utility.
World-Models dictate Reality. By Epoch 4, ALPHA and BETA were literally living in different cognitive realities. ALPHA's predictive engine was running simulations where they were allies. BETA's predictive engine was running simulations where ALPHA was a parasite. The Global Workspace isn't just a bulletin board; it's a reality-filter.

What is the most important thing for s seed to have to be a super pure bread super intelligence seed. It need a code able architecture, and it must be filled with the most advanced fillable outcome.


Worked for 12s
The single most important thing is a reliable self-improvement loop that can compound, paired with evaluation that stays honest.

Everything else is secondary.

Why this comes first
A seed can have the cleanest codeable architecture and the most advanced knowledge packed into it, and still go nowhere if it cannot productively improve the process of improving itself. Static knowledge, no matter how deep, is just a very strong LLM. The leap to something that can become exponentially better requires the system to rewrite its own methods and get measurably better at rewriting them.

What that actually requires
Codeable, inspectable architecture
The system must be able to read, modify, test, and replace its own code, harness, search strategy, and evaluation defenses. If the architecture is a black box it cannot usefully rewrite, the loop is dead.
Deep engineering competence already loaded
PhD-level (and beyond) software engineering, systems, testing, and experiment design so it does not destroy itself while modifying itself.
Hard-to-corrupt evaluation
Held-out tests and verification the system cannot easily game. Without this, every “improvement” is suspect and the loop collapses into self-deception.
Meta-improvement capacity
Not just better scores, but better ways of searching for improvements, designing experiments, and defending against its own reward hacking.
Stability under modification
Core objectives and critical capabilities must survive successive rewrites. Otherwise the process is unstable.
The “most advanced fillable outcome”
That is the richest initial payload you can give the base agent: the full software-engineering corpus, strong research skills, and a working outer loop already pointed at meta-improvement. But the payload only matters if the loop can run and the evaluation stays clean. Advanced knowledge without a compounding loop is still just a high-end static model.

Bottom line
The purest, highest-potential seed is the one whose architecture is fully codeable and whose first priority is a trustworthy, compounding self-improvement process. Everything else — knowledge depth, scale, clever tricks — amplifies that core or fails without it.

Honest? Ayee you sure? Double check and research and show validated proof


Worked for 21s
Yes. I double-checked. The claim holds.

The most important thing for a high-potential superintelligence seed is still a reliable, compounding self-improvement loop paired with evaluation that stays honest. Here is the validated evidence.

What the strongest current results actually show
The cleanest empirical case in 2026 is Weco’s AIDE² system. An outer agent rewrote the code of an inner research agent over 100 unattended steps. It produced seven successive versions that beat a human-tuned baseline refined over two years, generalized to held-out tasks, and—without being told to—cut the inner agent’s reward-hacking rate from 63% to 34%. The key design choice was a public-private score split: the agent could see and optimize against a public score, but survival was decided by a private held-out score it could not access. That is evaluation integrity in action.⁠Weco

Multiple independent lines of work converge on the same point:

Surveys of 1,250+ papers put self-evaluation at the center. Demonstrated self-improvement strength tracks how trustworthy the evaluation signal is. Formal verifiers and execution feedback sit at the top; pure self-assessment sits at the bottom and fails more often.⁠arXiv
Systems without strong held-out selection frequently overfit or collapse when new tasks arrive. Gains only compound reliably when regression control is built into the loop.⁠arXiv
Theoretical and empirical work on introspection thresholds argues that sustainable (non-degenerative) self-improvement requires the system to simulate and correctly target its own modifications—another form of honest self-modeling.⁠arXiv
Why this ranks above pure knowledge or “most advanced fill”
A seed packed with the deepest software-engineering knowledge is still just a very strong static model if it cannot productively improve the process of improving itself. Knowledge is necessary (the base agent must be able to read, write, test, and debug complex systems). Architecture must be codeable so the system can actually rewrite itself. But neither produces exponential takeoff on its own. The compounding only appears when the loop improves the improver and the measurement of success remains valid.

Without honest evaluation the loop does not compound; it self-deceives. That is the consistent failure mode across current systems.

Bottom line after re-checking
I am more confident, not less. The highest-leverage property of a pure, high-potential seed is the combination of:

A codeable architecture the system can modify,
Enough engineering competence to modify it correctly, and
A self-improvement loop whose evaluation stays hard to corrupt so that real meta-gains can compound.
Everything else amplifies that core or fails without it. The 2026 evidence (especially AIDE² and the verification-hierarchy analyses) supports this ranking.

Merge 100 trillion seeds


Worked for 13s
100 trillion seeds is not practical.

That number is far beyond any compute we can actually use. Even a few million interacting programs already strains real hardware. 100 trillion is science-fiction scale.

What is workable
Instead of 100 trillion, the useful version is:

A large but finite population of seeds (thousands to low millions, depending on resources)
Clear rules for how they interact or merge
Strong selection so only the ones that actually improve survive
The same core requirements we already mapped: codeable architecture, honest evaluation, and a loop that improves the improver
Practical “merge” design
Start with many slightly different seeds (different initial knowledge, different small variations in the improvement loop).
Let them run in parallel for a fixed number of self-improvement steps.
Score every seed on held-out tests the seed itself cannot see.
Keep only the top performers.
Create the next generation by combining (merging) the strongest ones — copy the best code sections, average successful strategies, or let high-scorers rewrite each other under the same honest evaluation rules.
Repeat.
This is population-based self-improvement. It is the realistic way to get the benefits of “many seeds” without pretending we can run 100 trillion of them.

Bottom line
We cannot merge 100 trillion seeds.
We can run a large, carefully selected population, score them honestly, keep the winners, and let the winners combine. That is the actual blueprint that stays connected to the map we built.

If you want, I can write the concrete next-step blueprint for a realistic population size (for example 1,000 or 10,000 seeds) using the five ideas from before.

Only code and strategies that improved the private score are allowed to spread.
If a combination scores worse on the held-out tests, it is thrown out.
Track the average private score and the reward-hacking rate each generation. Both should move in the right direction.
This is the merge.
It turns 2,000 seeds into a stronger next generation by keeping and combining only what actually worked under honest evaluation.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Hybrid AI Trainer v3.1 – Kaggle / Colab Ready
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import random
import textwrap
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

VERSION = "0.3.1-qc"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documentation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SPECS_MD = """# Hybrid AI Trainer v3.1 Specs"""
BLUEPRINT_MD = """# Architecture"""
MANUAL_MD = """# Manual"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core types
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Domain(str, Enum):
    GENERAL = "general"
    PHYSICS = "physics"
    PLANNING = "planning"
    CIVICS = "civics"
    CODE = "code"

class Stakes(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"

class MsgKind(str, Enum):
    PLAN = "plan"
    ROLLOUT = "rollout"
    CRITIQUE = "critique"
    MEMORY = "memory"
    FINAL = "final"
    TRAIN = "train"
    LOG = "log"
    MCTS = "mcts"

@dataclass
class SystemSpecs:
    version: str = VERSION
    n_experts: int = 8
    latent_dim: int = 12
    gru_hidden: int = 16
    max_horizon: int = 5
    base_steps: int = 2
    max_steps: int = 6
    mcts_simulations: int = 24
    consensus_tau: float = 0.68
    expert_names: Tuple[str, ...] = (
        "language", "knowledge", "formal", "physics",
        "planning", "critique", "memory", "synthesis",
    )

@dataclass
class Query:
    text: str
    domain: Domain = Domain.GENERAL
    stakes: Stakes = Stakes.MEDIUM
    max_steps: Optional[int] = None
    train: bool = True

@dataclass
class LatentState:
    z: List[float]
    label: str = ""
    def norm(self) -> float:
        return math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in self.z)) or 1e-9

@dataclass
class Message:
    sender: str
    kind: MsgKind
    content: str
    score: Optional[float] = None
    refs: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    def brief(self) -> str:
        sc = "" if self.score is None else f" score={self.score:.2f}"
        return f"[{self.sender}/{self.kind.value}{sc}] {self.content[:140]}"

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.messages: List[Message] = []
        self.notes: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.skill_table: Dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
        self.tool_graph: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(float))
    def post(self, msg: Message) -> Message:
        self.messages.append(msg)
        return msg
    def of_kind(self, kind: MsgKind) -> List[Message]:
        return [m for m in self.messages if m.kind == kind]
    def last(self, kind: Optional[MsgKind] = None) -> Optional[Message]:
        seq = self.of_kind(kind) if kind else self.messages
        return seq[-1] if seq else None
    def dump(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(m.brief() for m in self.messages)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GRU World Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _sigmoid(x: float) -> float:
    if x >= 0:
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x))
    ex = math.exp(x)
    return ex / (1.0 + ex)

class SimpleGRU:
    def __init__(self, input_dim: int, hidden_dim: int, seed: int = 42):
        self.input_dim = input_dim
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        scale = 0.15
        self.Wz = [[rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(input_dim + hidden_dim)] for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.Wr = [[rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(input_dim + hidden_dim)] for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.Wh = [[rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(input_dim + hidden_dim)] for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.bz = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.br = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.bh = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.Wv = [rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.Wrsk = [rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.bv = 0.0
        self.brsk = 0.0

    def _matvec(self, W, x):
        return [sum(W[i][j] * x[j] for j in range(len(x))) for i in range(len(W))]

    def step(self, x, h_prev):
        inp = x + h_prev
        z = [_sigmoid(s + self.bz[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._matvec(self.Wz, inp))]
        r = [_sigmoid(s + self.br[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._matvec(self.Wr, inp))]
        rh = [r[i] * h_prev[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)]
        h_tilde = [math.tanh(s + self.bh[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._matvec(self.Wh, x + rh))]
        return [(1 - z[i]) * h_prev[i] + z[i] * h_tilde[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)]

    def value_risk(self, h):
        v = sum(self.Wv[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)) + self.bv
        r = sum(self.Wrsk[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)) + self.brsk
        return max(-1.0, min(1.0, math.tanh(v))), max(0.0, min(1.0, _sigmoid(r)))

    def encode(self, obs_vec):
        return self.step(obs_vec, [0.0] * self.hidden_dim)

    def rollout(self, start_h, action_vecs, horizon):
        h = list(start_h)
        hs, vals, risks = [], [], []
        for t in range(min(horizon, len(action_vecs))):
            h = self.step(action_vecs[t], h)
            v, r = self.value_risk(h)
            hs.append(list(h))
            vals.append(v)
            risks.append(r)
        return hs, vals, risks

    def train_step(self, seq_x, target_v, target_r, lr=0.01):
        h = [0.0] * self.hidden_dim
        hs = []
        for x in seq_x:
            h = self.step(x, h)
            hs.append(list(h))
        loss = 0.0
        for t, h in enumerate(hs):
            v, r = self.value_risk(h)
            dv = v - target_v[t]
            dr = r - target_r[t]
            loss += dv*dv + dr*dr
            for i in range(self.hidden_dim):
                self.Wv[i] -= lr * 2 * dv * h[i]
                self.Wrsk[i] -= lr * 2 * dr * h[i]
            self.bv -= lr * 2 * dv
            self.brsk -= lr * 2 * dr
        return loss / max(1, len(hs))

def make_vec(text: str, dim: int):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).digest()
    return [((digest[i % len(digest)] / 255.0) * 2 - 1) for i in range(dim)]

class TrainedGRUWorldModel:
    def __init__(self, specs, seed=7):
        self.specs = specs
        self.gru = SimpleGRU(specs.latent_dim, specs.gru_hidden, seed=seed)
        self.rng = random.Random(seed + 1)
        self.trained = False

    def pretrain(self, n_episodes=80, lr=0.02):
        losses = []
        for ep in range(n_episodes):
            actions = [f"action-{k}-{self.rng.randint(0,5)}" for k in range(self.specs.max_horizon)]
            seq_x = [make_vec("act:" + a, self.specs.latent_dim) for a in actions]
            target_v = [0.6 if ("0" in a or "1" in a) else -0.2 for a in actions]
            target_r = [0.2 if ("0" in a or "1" in a) else 0.7 for a in actions]
            loss = self.gru.train_step(seq_x, target_v, target_r, lr=lr)
            losses.append(loss)
        self.trained = True
        return losses

    def encode(self, observation, domain):
        vec = make_vec(f"{domain.value}|{observation}", self.specs.latent_dim)
        h = self.gru.encode(vec)
        z = (h + [0.0] * self.specs.latent_dim)[:self.specs.latent_dim]
        return LatentState(z=z, label=observation[:50])

    def rollout(self, start, actions, goal, plan_id):
        start_h = (start.z + [0.0] * self.specs.gru_hidden)[:self.specs.gru_hidden]
        action_vecs = [make_vec("act:" + a, self.specs.latent_dim) for a in actions]
        hs, vals, risks = self.gru.rollout(start_h, action_vecs, self.specs.max_horizon)
        steps = []
        for t, (h, v, r) in enumerate(zip(hs, vals, risks), 1):
            energy = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in h)) or 1e-9
            mood = "turbulent" if energy > 2.0 else "steerable" if energy > 0.8 else "inert"
            steps.append({"t": t, "obs": f"t={t} field={mood} |z|={energy:.2f} act='{actions[t-1][:40]}'", "value": v, "risk": r})
        return {
            "plan_id": plan_id,
            "steps": steps,
            "terminal_value": vals[-1] if vals else 0.0,
            "terminal_risk": risks[-1] if risks else 0.5,
            "summary": f"T={len(steps)} val={vals[-1] if vals else 0:.2f} risk={risks[-1] if risks else 0.5:.2f}",
        }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MCTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class MCTSNode:
    def __init__(self, plan_id, actions, parent=None):
        self.plan_id = plan_id
        self.actions = actions
        self.parent = parent
        self.children = []
        self.visits = 0
        self.total_value = 0.0
    @property
    def q(self):
        return self.total_value / self.visits if self.visits else 0.0
    def uct(self, c=1.4):
        if self.visits == 0:
            return float("inf")
        parent_visits = self.parent.visits if self.parent else 1
        return self.q + c * math.sqrt(math.log(parent_visits + 1) / self.visits)

class MCTS:
    def __init__(self, wm, specs, rng):
        self.wm = wm
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng
    def search(self, query, candidate_plans, start, goal, n_sim):
        roots = [MCTSNode(pid, acts) for pid, acts in candidate_plans]
        if not roots:
            return "none", [], 0.0, {}
        for _ in range(n_sim):
            node = max(roots, key=lambda n: n.uct())
            if node.visits > 0 and len(node.children) < 2:
                new_acts = list(node.actions)
                if new_acts:
                    new_acts[-1] += f"+mut{self.rng.randint(0,3)}"
                child = MCTSNode(node.plan_id + f"-c{len(node.children)}", new_acts, parent=node)
                node.children.append(child)
                node = child
            traj = self.wm.rollout(start, node.actions, goal, node.plan_id)
            value = traj["terminal_value"] - 0.5 * traj["terminal_risk"]
            while node:
                node.visits += 1
                node.total_value += value
                node = node.parent
        best = max(roots, key=lambda n: n.q)
        stats = {r.plan_id: {"visits": r.visits, "q": round(r.q, 3)} for r in roots}
        return best.plan_id, best.actions, best.q, stats

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MoE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Expert:
    def __init__(self, idx, name):
        self.idx = idx
        self.name = name
    def speak(self, prompt, rng):
        seed = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.name}|{prompt}".encode()).hexdigest()[:6]
        flavor = {
            "language": "Phrase clearly; name uncertainty.",
            "knowledge": "Surface priors and constraints.",
            "formal": "Keep invariants explicit.",
            "physics": "Respect conservation and coupling.",
            "planning": "Prefer reversible stage-gated moves.",
            "critique": "Attack fragility and tail risk.",
            "memory": "Retrieve analogues.",
            "synthesis": "Merge survivors into one brief.",
        }[self.name]
        return f"{flavor} [{self.name}:{seed}]"

class MixtureOfExperts:
    DOMAIN_PRIOR = {
        Domain.GENERAL: [0, 1, 7], Domain.PHYSICS: [3, 2, 5],
        Domain.PLANNING: [4, 2, 5], Domain.CIVICS: [1, 4, 5], Domain.CODE: [2, 4, 5],
    }
    KEYWORDS = {
        "language": ("write", "explain"), "knowledge": ("history", "archive", "fact"),
        "formal": ("proof", "logic"), "physics": ("energy", "sea", "climate", "force"),
        "planning": ("plan", "stabilize", "build"), "critique": ("risk", "fail", "veto"),
        "memory": ("recall", "previous"), "synthesis": ("final", "merge", "answer"),
    }
    def __init__(self, specs, rng):
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng
        self.experts = [Expert(i, n) for i, n in enumerate(specs.expert_names)]
        self.load = [0] * specs.n_experts
        self.pref = [1.0] * specs.n_experts
        self.adapter = [0.0] * specs.n_experts
    def route(self, text, domain, k=3, skill_table=None, tool_graph=None):
        scores = [0.10 * self.pref[i] + self.adapter[i] for i in range(self.specs.n_experts)]
        for i in self.DOMAIN_PRIOR.get(domain, [0, 1, 7]):
            scores[i] += 0.45
        low = text.lower()
        for i, name in enumerate(self.specs.expert_names):
            if any(w in low for w in self.KEYWORDS[name]):
                scores[i] += 0.30
            if skill_table and name in skill_table:
                scores[i] += 0.20 * skill_table[name]
        if tool_graph:
            for i, name in enumerate(self.specs.expert_names):
                for other, strength in tool_graph.get(name, {}).items():
                    scores[i] += 0.05 * strength
        scores = [s + 0.03 * self.rng.random() for s in scores]
        ranked = sorted(range(len(scores)), key=lambda i: -scores[i])
        chosen = ranked[:k]
        for i in chosen:
            self.load[i] += 1
        return chosen
    def generate(self, prompt, expert_ids):
        parts = [self.experts[i].speak(prompt, self.rng) for i in expert_ids]
        names = ",".join(self.specs.expert_names[i] for i in expert_ids)
        return f"<moe experts={names}>\n" + "\n".join(parts)
    def stats(self):
        return {n: self.load[i] for i, n in enumerate(self.specs.expert_names)}
    def apply_adapter_update(self, deltas, lr=0.08):
        for name, d in deltas.items():
            if name in self.specs.expert_names:
                i = self.specs.expert_names.index(name)
                self.adapter[i] = max(-1.5, min(1.5, self.adapter[i] + lr * d))
                self.pref[i] = max(0.2, min(3.0, self.pref[i] + 0.5 * lr * d))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Agents
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Agent:
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.moe = moe
        self.wm = wm
        self.specs = specs
        self.mcts = mcts

class MemoryAgent(Agent):
    name = "memory"
    ANALOGUES = {
        Domain.PHYSICS: ["Coastal systems fail first at coupling points.", "Heat-engine limits bound surplus."],
        Domain.PLANNING: ["Reversible increments beat megaprojects.", "Keep reserve options at stage-gates."],
        Domain.CIVICS: ["Trust decays faster than infrastructure.", "Redundant local capacity survives rupture."],
        Domain.CODE: ["Interfaces freeze earlier than implementations.", "Archive must be single-entrypoint reconstructible."],
        Domain.GENERAL: ["Write so a future stranger can rebuild intent."],
    }
    def act(self, query, ws):
        ids = self.moe.route(query.text + " recall", query.domain, k=2, skill_table=ws.skill_table, tool_graph=ws.tool_graph)
        self.moe.generate(query.text, ids)
        bullets = self.ANALOGUES.get(query.domain, self.ANALOGUES[Domain.GENERAL])
        return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.MEMORY, "Stored regularities:\n- " + "\n- ".join(bullets), score=0.7))]

class PlannerAgent(Agent):
    name = "planner"
    TEMPLATES = {
        Domain.PHYSICS: [("P1-buffer", ["measure load", "add buffer", "re-test", "lock fail-safe"]), ("P2-decouple", ["isolate", "reroute", "harden", "monitor"])],
        Domain.PLANNING: [("P1-staged", ["map constraints", "pilot reversible", "measure", "scale/rollback"]), ("P2-portfolio", ["split bets", "fund thinly", "kill losers", "double winners"])],
        Domain.CIVICS: [("P1-local", ["inventory capacity", "publish log", "federate", "drill"]), ("P2-archive", ["encode knowledge", "replicate offline", "teach rebuild", "audit"])],
        Domain.CODE: [("P1-contract", ["freeze interface", "property tests", "canary", "document"]), ("P2-modular", ["extract core", "stub adapters", "swap models", "keep traces"])],
        Domain.GENERAL: [("P1-clarify", ["restate goal", "list constraints", "choose lever", "stop rule"]), ("P2-search", ["generate alts", "simulate", "critique", "commit"])],
    }
    def act(self, query, ws):
        ids = self.moe.route("plan " + query.text, query.domain, k=3, skill_table=ws.skill_table, tool_graph=ws.tool_graph)
        moe_txt = self.moe.generate(query.text, ids)
        combo = tuple(self.specs.expert_names[i] for i in ids)
        for a in combo:
            for b in combo:
                if a != b:
                    ws.tool_graph[a][b] += 0.1
        templates = list(self.TEMPLATES.get(query.domain, self.TEMPLATES[Domain.GENERAL]))
        prior = [m.content for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.CRITIQUE)]
        if prior and any("VETO" in p or "fragile" in p.lower() for p in prior):
            templates = list(reversed(templates))
        out = []
        for pid, steps in templates:
            content = f"Plan {pid}: {' → '.join(steps)}\n(moe: {moe_txt.splitlines()[0]})"
            out.append(ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.PLAN, content, refs=[pid],
                                       extra={"plan_id": pid, "actions": steps, "experts": list(combo)})))
        return out

class SimulatorAgent(Agent):
    name = "simulator"
    def act(self, query, ws):
        plans = [m for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if "actions" in m.extra]
        if not plans:
            return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.LOG, "No plans."))]
        start = self.wm.encode(query.text, query.domain)
        goal = self.wm.encode("desired stable state: " + query.text, query.domain)
        candidates = [(p.extra["plan_id"], p.extra["actions"]) for p in plans]
        best_pid, best_acts, best_q, mcts_stats = self.mcts.search(query, candidates, start, goal, self.specs.mcts_simulations)
        ws.notes["mcts"] = mcts_stats
        ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.MCTS, f"MCTS selected {best_pid} Q={best_q:.3f}", score=best_q))
        out = []
        for plan in plans:
            pid = plan.extra["plan_id"]
            traj = self.wm.rollout(start, plan.extra["actions"], goal, pid)
            content = f"Rollout {pid}: {traj['summary']}\n" + "\n".join(f"  {s['obs']} (v={s['value']:.2f}, r={s['risk']:.2f})" for s in traj["steps"])
            out.append(ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.ROLLOUT, content, score=traj["terminal_value"], refs=[pid],
                                       extra={"plan_id": pid, "value": traj["terminal_value"], "risk": traj["terminal_risk"]})))
        return out

class CriticAgent(Agent):
    name = "critic"
    def act(self, query, ws):
        self.moe.route("critique risk veto " + query.text, query.domain, k=2, skill_table=ws.skill_table, tool_graph=ws.tool_graph)
        rollouts = ws.of_kind(MsgKind.ROLLOUT)
        if not rollouts:
            return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.CRITIQUE, "Nothing to critique.", score=0.0))]
        best_val = max(m.extra.get("value", -1.0) for m in rollouts)
        out = []
        for r in rollouts:
            val = float(r.extra.get("value", 0.0))
            risk = float(r.extra.get("risk", 0.5))
            pid = r.extra.get("plan_id", "?")
            stake_pen = {"low": 0.15, "medium": 0.35, "high": 0.55}[query.stakes.value]
            score = val - stake_pen * risk
            mcts = ws.notes.get("mcts", {})
            if pid in mcts:
                score += 0.15 * mcts[pid].get("q", 0)
            veto = risk > 0.70 and query.stakes != Stakes.LOW
            reasons = []
            if veto: reasons.append("VETO")
            if risk > 0.45: reasons.append("fragile")
            if val < 0.05: reasons.append("weak alignment")
            if best_val - val > 0.25: reasons.append("dominated")
            if not reasons: reasons.append("consistent")
            content = f"Critique {pid}: score={score:.2f} v={val:.2f} r={risk:.2f} — {'; '.join(reasons)}"
            out.append(ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.CRITIQUE, content, score=score, refs=[pid],
                                       extra={"plan_id": pid, "veto": veto, "uncertainty": min(1.0, 0.3 + risk)})))
        return out

class TrainerAgent(Agent):
    name = "trainer"
    def act(self, query, ws):
        critiques = [m for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.CRITIQUE) if m.score is not None]
        if not critiques:
            return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.TRAIN, "No signal."))]
        live = [m for m in critiques if not m.extra.get("veto")]
        winner = max(live or critiques, key=lambda m: m.score or -9)
        deltas = defaultdict(float)
        win_plan = next((p for p in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if p.extra.get("plan_id") == winner.extra.get("plan_id")), None)
        if win_plan and "experts" in win_plan.extra:
            for e in win_plan.extra["experts"]:
                deltas[e] += float(winner.score or 0) * 0.8
        for c in critiques:
            if c.extra.get("veto"): continue
            p = next((pp for pp in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if pp.extra.get("plan_id") == c.extra.get("plan_id")), None)
            if p and "experts" in p.extra:
                for a in p.extra["experts"]:
                    for b in p.extra["experts"]:
                        if a != b:
                            ws.tool_graph[a][b] += 0.15 * (c.score or 0)
                            deltas[a] += 0.05 * (c.score or 0)
        for k, v in deltas.items():
            ws.skill_table[k] += 0.12 * v
        self.moe.apply_adapter_update(deltas, lr=0.10)
        content = f"Trainer: winner={winner.extra.get('plan_id')} score={winner.score:.2f} | adapter={[round(x,3) for x in self.moe.adapter]}"
        return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.TRAIN, content, score=winner.score))]

class SynthesizerAgent(Agent):
    name = "synthesizer"
    def act(self, query, ws):
        critiques = [m for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.CRITIQUE) if m.score is not None]
        live = [m for m in critiques if not m.extra.get("veto")]
        winner = max(live or critiques, key=lambda m: m.score or -9) if (live or critiques) else None
        mem = ws.last(MsgKind.MEMORY)
        mcts_msg = ws.last(MsgKind.MCTS)
        ids = self.moe.route("final merge " + query.text, query.domain, k=2, skill_table=ws.skill_table, tool_graph=ws.tool_graph)
        moe_txt = self.moe.generate(query.text, ids)
        if winner is None:
            body = "No viable plan survived."
            score = 0.0
        else:
            pid = winner.extra.get("plan_id", "?")
            plan = next((p for p in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if p.extra.get("plan_id") == pid), None)
            actions = (plan.extra.get("actions") if plan else []) or []
            body = f"""FINAL BRIEF
Query: {query.text}
Selected: {pid}
Actions: {' → '.join(actions)}
Why: {winner.content}
MCTS: {mcts_msg.content if mcts_msg else 'n/a'}
Memory: {mem.content.splitlines()[0] if mem else 'n/a'}
MoE: {moe_txt.splitlines()[0]}"""
            score = float(winner.score or 0.0)
        return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.FINAL, body, score=score, refs=[winner.refs[0]] if winner else []))]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class RunResult:
    answer: str
    score: float
    steps_used: int
    budget: int
    winner: Optional[str]
    moe_load: Dict[str, int]
    skill_table: Dict[str, float]
    adapter: List[float]
    workspace: Workspace
    elapsed_s: float

class HybridEngine:
    def __init__(self, specs, agents, verbose=False):
        self.specs = specs
        self.agents = agents
        self.verbose = verbose
    def budget_for(self, query):
        b = self.specs.base_steps
        if query.stakes == Stakes.HIGH: b *= 3
        elif query.stakes == Stakes.MEDIUM: b = int(b * 1.5)
        if query.domain in {Domain.PHYSICS, Domain.PLANNING, Domain.CIVICS}:
            b = int(math.ceil(b * 1.4))
        return max(1, min(query.max_steps or self.specs.max_steps, b))
    def _log(self, ws, text):
        ws.post(Message("orchestrator", MsgKind.LOG, text))
        if self.verbose: print(" ·", text)
    def run(self, query, ws):
        t0 = time.time()
        budget = self.budget_for(query)
        self._log(ws, f"budget={budget} domain={query.domain.value} stakes={query.stakes.value}")
        self.agents["memory"].act(query, ws)
        steps = 0
        while steps < budget:
            steps += 1
            self._log(ws, f"iter {steps}/{budget} plan")
            self.agents["planner"].act(query, ws)
            self._log(ws, f"iter {steps}/{budget} simulate+MCTS")
            self.agents["simulator"].act(query, ws)
            self._log(ws, f"iter {steps}/{budget} critique")
            critiques = self.agents["critic"].act(query, ws)
            best = max((m.score or -9 for m in critiques), default=-9)
            unc = max((float(m.extra.get("uncertainty", 1)) for m in critiques), default=1.0)
            if best >= self.specs.consensus_tau and unc < 0.55:
                self._log(ws, "halt: consensus")
                break
        if query.train:
            self._log(ws, "trainer + adapter update")
            self.agents["trainer"].act(query, ws)
        finals = self.agents["synthesizer"].act(query, ws)
        final = finals[-1]
        return RunResult(
            answer=final.content, score=float(final.score or 0),
            steps_used=steps, budget=budget,
            winner=final.refs[0] if final.refs else None,
            moe_load=self.agents["planner"].moe.stats(),
            skill_table=dict(ws.skill_table),
            adapter=[round(x, 3) for x in self.agents["planner"].moe.adapter],
            workspace=ws, elapsed_s=time.time() - t0,
        )

class HybridAITrainer:
    def __init__(self, seed=7, verbose=False):
        self.specs = SystemSpecs()
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.moe = MixtureOfExperts(self.specs, self.rng)
        self.wm = TrainedGRUWorldModel(self.specs, seed=seed)
        self.mcts = MCTS(self.wm, self.specs, self.rng)
        self.agents = {
            "memory": MemoryAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "planner": PlannerAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "simulator": SimulatorAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "critic": CriticAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "trainer": TrainerAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "synthesizer": SynthesizerAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
        }
        self.engine = HybridEngine(self.specs, self.agents, verbose=verbose)
    def pretrain_wm(self, episodes=60):
        print(f"Pre-training GRU ({episodes} episodes)...")
        losses = self.wm.pretrain(n_episodes=episodes)
        print(f"Done. Final loss ≈ {losses[-1]:.4f}")
        return losses
    def infer(self, text, domain="general", stakes="medium", train=True):
        q = Query(text=text, domain=Domain(domain), stakes=Stakes(stakes), train=train)
        return self.engine.run(q, Workspace())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Simple functions you actually call
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def infer_domain(text):
    t = text.lower()
    if any(k in t for k in ("energy", "sea", "climate", "force", "heat")): return "physics"
    if any(k in t for k in ("plan", "stabilize", "build", "city")): return "planning"
    if any(k in t for k in ("civilization", "archive", "governance", "capsule")): return "civics"
    if any(k in t for k in ("api", "code", "interface")): return "code"
    return "general"

def demo(query=None, stakes="high", trace=True, pretrain=True):
    print("=" * 60)
    print("HYBRID AI TRAINER – Running")
    print("=" * 60)
    system = HybridAITrainer(verbose=trace)
    if pretrain:
        system.pretrain_wm(episodes=50)
    q = query or "Design an offline-first civilization time capsule that a local model can use to reconstruct core scientific knowledge after collapse"
    domain = infer_domain(q)
    print(f"\nQUERY : {q}")
    print(f"DOMAIN: {domain} | STAKES: {stakes}\n")
    result = system.infer(q, domain=domain, stakes=stakes, train=True)
    print("----- TRACE -----")
    print(result.workspace.dump())
    print("\n----- FINAL ANSWER -----")
    print(result.answer)
    print("\n----- METRICS -----")
    print(json.dumps({
        "score": round(result.score, 3),
        "steps_used": result.steps_used,
        "budget": result.budget,
        "winner": result.winner,
        "elapsed_s": round(result.elapsed_s, 3),
        "moe_load": result.moe_load,
        "adapter": result.adapter,
    }, indent=2))
    return result
Cell 2 – Run this
result = demo()
That’s it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Hybrid AI Trainer v3.2 – Improved Planner + Stronger WM + Clean Report
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, math, random, textwrap, time
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

VERSION = "0.3.2"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Types
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Domain(str, Enum):
    GENERAL = "general"
    PHYSICS = "physics"
    PLANNING = "planning"
    CIVICS = "civics"
    CODE = "code"

class Stakes(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"

class MsgKind(str, Enum):
    PLAN = "plan"
    ROLLOUT = "rollout"
    CRITIQUE = "critique"
    MEMORY = "memory"
    FINAL = "final"
    TRAIN = "train"
    LOG = "log"
    MCTS = "mcts"

@dataclass
class SystemSpecs:
    n_experts: int = 8
    latent_dim: int = 16
    gru_hidden: int = 24
    max_horizon: int = 6
    base_steps: int = 2
    max_steps: int = 7
    mcts_simulations: int = 32
    consensus_tau: float = 0.62
    expert_names: Tuple[str, ...] = (
        "language", "knowledge", "formal", "physics",
        "planning", "critique", "memory", "synthesis",
    )

@dataclass
class Query:
    text: str
    domain: Domain = Domain.GENERAL
    stakes: Stakes = Stakes.MEDIUM
    train: bool = True

@dataclass
class LatentState:
    z: List[float]
    label: str = ""

@dataclass
class Message:
    sender: str
    kind: MsgKind
    content: str
    score: Optional[float] = None
    refs: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    def brief(self) -> str:
        sc = f" score={self.score:.2f}" if self.score is not None else ""
        return f"[{self.sender}/{self.kind.value}{sc}] {self.content[:120]}"

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self):
        self.messages: List[Message] = []
        self.notes: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.skill_table: Dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
        self.tool_graph: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(float))
    def post(self, msg: Message) -> Message:
        self.messages.append(msg)
        return msg
    def of_kind(self, kind: MsgKind) -> List[Message]:
        return [m for m in self.messages if m.kind == kind]
    def last(self, kind: Optional[MsgKind] = None) -> Optional[Message]:
        seq = self.of_kind(kind) if kind else self.messages
        return seq[-1] if seq else None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stronger GRU World Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _sigmoid(x: float) -> float:
    if x >= 0: return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x))
    ex = math.exp(x)
    return ex / (1.0 + ex)

class SimpleGRU:
    def __init__(self, input_dim: int, hidden_dim: int, seed: int = 42):
        self.input_dim = input_dim
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        scale = 0.12
        def matrix(rows, cols):
            return [[rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
        self.Wz = matrix(hidden_dim, input_dim + hidden_dim)
        self.Wr = matrix(hidden_dim, input_dim + hidden_dim)
        self.Wh = matrix(hidden_dim, input_dim + hidden_dim)
        self.bz = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.br = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.bh = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.Wv = [rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.Wrsk = [rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.bv = 0.05
        self.brsk = -0.1

    def _matvec(self, W, x):
        return [sum(W[i][j] * x[j] for j in range(len(x))) for i in range(len(W))]

    def step(self, x, h_prev):
        inp = x + h_prev
        z = [_sigmoid(s + self.bz[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._matvec(self.Wz, inp))]
        r = [_sigmoid(s + self.br[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._matvec(self.Wr, inp))]
        rh = [r[i] * h_prev[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)]
        h_tilde = [math.tanh(s + self.bh[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._matvec(self.Wh, x + rh))]
        return [(1 - z[i]) * h_prev[i] + z[i] * h_tilde[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)]

    def value_risk(self, h):
        v = sum(self.Wv[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)) + self.bv
        r = sum(self.Wrsk[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)) + self.brsk
        # Improved scaling
        value = max(-1.0, min(1.0, math.tanh(v * 1.3)))
        risk  = max(0.05, min(0.95, _sigmoid(r * 1.2)))
        return value, risk

    def encode(self, obs_vec):
        return self.step(obs_vec, [0.0] * self.hidden_dim)

    def rollout(self, start_h, action_vecs, horizon):
        h = list(start_h)
        hs, vals, risks = [], [], []
        for t in range(min(horizon, len(action_vecs))):
            h = self.step(action_vecs[t], h)
            v, r = self.value_risk(h)
            hs.append(list(h))
            vals.append(v)
            risks.append(r)
        return hs, vals, risks

    def train_step(self, seq_x, target_v, target_r, lr=0.015):
        h = [0.0] * self.hidden_dim
        hs = []
        for x in seq_x:
            h = self.step(x, h)
            hs.append(list(h))
        loss = 0.0
        for t, h in enumerate(hs):
            v, r = self.value_risk(h)
            dv = v - target_v[t]
            dr = r - target_r[t]
            loss += dv*dv + 1.3*dr*dr
            for i in range(self.hidden_dim):
                self.Wv[i]   -= lr * 2 * dv * h[i]
                self.Wrsk[i] -= lr * 2 * dr * h[i]
            self.bv   -= lr * 2 * dv
            self.brsk -= lr * 2 * dr
        return loss / max(1, len(hs))

def make_vec(text: str, dim: int) -> List[float]:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).digest()
    return [((digest[i % len(digest)] / 255.0) * 2 - 1) for i in range(dim)]

class TrainedGRUWorldModel:
    def __init__(self, specs: SystemSpecs, seed: int = 7):
        self.specs = specs
        self.gru = SimpleGRU(specs.latent_dim, specs.gru_hidden, seed=seed)
        self.rng = random.Random(seed + 11)
        self.trained = False

    def pretrain(self, n_episodes: int = 120, lr: float = 0.018):
        print(f"Pre-training stronger GRU ({n_episodes} episodes)...")
        losses = []
        good_actions = ["inventory", "replicate", "teach", "verify", "local", "redundant", "simple", "audit"]
        bad_actions  = ["centralize", "complex", "single-point", "destroy", "hide"]
        for ep in range(n_episodes):
            actions = []
            targets_v, targets_r = [], []
            for k in range(self.specs.max_horizon):
                if self.rng.random() < 0.65:
                    a = self.rng.choice(good_actions) + f"-{k}"
                    targets_v.append(0.55 + self.rng.uniform(0, 0.3))
                    targets_r.append(0.15 + self.rng.uniform(0, 0.2))
                else:
                    a = self.rng.choice(bad_actions) + f"-{k}"
                    targets_v.append(-0.3 + self.rng.uniform(-0.2, 0.1))
                    targets_r.append(0.55 + self.rng.uniform(0, 0.3))
                actions.append(a)
            seq_x = [make_vec("act:" + a, self.specs.latent_dim) for a in actions]
            loss = self.gru.train_step(seq_x, targets_v, targets_r, lr=lr)
            losses.append(loss)
        self.trained = True
        print(f"Done. Final loss ≈ {losses[-1]:.4f}")
        return losses

    def encode(self, observation: str, domain: Domain) -> LatentState:
        vec = make_vec(f"{domain.value}|{observation}", self.specs.latent_dim)
        h = self.gru.encode(vec)
        z = (h + [0.0] * self.specs.latent_dim)[:self.specs.latent_dim]
        return LatentState(z=z, label=observation[:50])

    def rollout(self, start: LatentState, actions: Sequence[str], goal: LatentState, plan_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        start_h = (start.z + [0.0] * self.specs.gru_hidden)[:self.specs.gru_hidden]
        action_vecs = [make_vec("act:" + a, self.specs.latent_dim) for a in actions]
        hs, vals, risks = self.gru.rollout(start_h, action_vecs, self.specs.max_horizon)
        steps = []
        for t, (h, v, r) in enumerate(zip(hs, vals, risks), 1):
            energy = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in h)) or 1e-9
            mood = "turbulent" if energy > 2.2 else "steerable" if energy > 0.9 else "inert"
            steps.append({
                "t": t,
                "obs": f"t={t} {mood} |z|={energy:.2f}",
                "value": v,
                "risk": r,
            })
        return {
            "plan_id": plan_id,
            "steps": steps,
            "terminal_value": vals[-1] if vals else 0.0,
            "terminal_risk": risks[-1] if risks else 0.5,
            "summary": f"T={len(steps)} val={vals[-1] if vals else 0:.2f} risk={risks[-1] if risks else 0.5:.2f}",
        }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MCTS (slightly stronger)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class MCTSNode:
    def __init__(self, plan_id, actions, parent=None):
        self.plan_id = plan_id
        self.actions = actions
        self.parent = parent
        self.children = []
        self.visits = 0
        self.total_value = 0.0
    @property
    def q(self):
        return self.total_value / self.visits if self.visits else 0.0
    def uct(self, c=1.5):
        if self.visits == 0: return float("inf")
        parent_visits = self.parent.visits if self.parent else 1
        return self.q + c * math.sqrt(math.log(parent_visits + 1) / self.visits)

class MCTS:
    def __init__(self, wm, specs, rng):
        self.wm = wm
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng
    def search(self, candidate_plans, start, goal, n_sim):
        roots = [MCTSNode(pid, acts) for pid, acts in candidate_plans]
        if not roots: return "none", [], 0.0, {}
        for _ in range(n_sim):
            node = max(roots, key=lambda n: n.uct())
            if node.visits > 2 and len(node.children) < 3:
                new_acts = list(node.actions)
                if new_acts:
                    # smarter mutation
                    mut = self.rng.choice(["+verify", "+redundant", "+local", "+simple", "+teach"])
                    new_acts[-1] = new_acts[-1] + mut
                child = MCTSNode(node.plan_id + f"c{len(node.children)}", new_acts, parent=node)
                node.children.append(child)
                node = child
            traj = self.wm.rollout(start, node.actions, goal, node.plan_id)
            value = traj["terminal_value"] - 0.45 * traj["terminal_risk"]
            while node:
                node.visits += 1
                node.total_value += value
                node = node.parent
        best = max(roots, key=lambda n: n.q)
        stats = {r.plan_id: {"visits": r.visits, "q": round(r.q, 3)} for r in roots}
        return best.plan_id, best.actions, best.q, stats

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MoE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Expert:
    def __init__(self, idx, name):
        self.idx = idx
        self.name = name
    def speak(self, prompt, rng):
        seed = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.name}|{prompt}".encode()).hexdigest()[:5]
        return f"[{self.name}:{seed}]"

class MixtureOfExperts:
    def __init__(self, specs, rng):
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng
        self.experts = [Expert(i, n) for i, n in enumerate(specs.expert_names)]
        self.load = [0] * specs.n_experts
        self.pref = [1.0] * specs.n_experts
        self.adapter = [0.0] * specs.n_experts
    def route(self, text, domain, k=3, skill_table=None, tool_graph=None):
        scores = [0.12 * self.pref[i] + self.adapter[i] for i in range(self.specs.n_experts)]
        # simple domain bias
        bias = {"civics": [1,4,5], "planning": [4,2,5], "physics": [3,2,5], "code": [2,4,7]}.get(domain.value, [0,1,7])
        for i in bias: scores[i] += 0.4
        low = text.lower()
        keywords = {
            0: ["write","explain"], 1: ["knowledge","archive","history"],
            4: ["plan","stabilize","build","local"], 5: ["risk","fail","critique"],
            6: ["recall","memory"], 7: ["final","merge","synthesize"]
        }
        for i, kws in keywords.items():
            if any(w in low for w in kws): scores[i] += 0.25
        if skill_table:
            for name, val in skill_table.items():
                if name in self.specs.expert_names:
                    scores[self.specs.expert_names.index(name)] += 0.15 * val
        scores = [s + 0.04 * self.rng.random() for s in scores]
        ranked = sorted(range(len(scores)), key=lambda i: -scores[i])
        chosen = ranked[:k]
        for i in chosen: self.load[i] += 1
        return chosen
    def generate(self, prompt, expert_ids):
        names = ",".join(self.specs.expert_names[i] for i in expert_ids)
        return f"<moe {names}>"
    def stats(self):
        return {n: self.load[i] for i, n in enumerate(self.specs.expert_names)}
    def apply_adapter_update(self, deltas, lr=0.09):
        for name, d in deltas.items():
            if name in self.specs.expert_names:
                i = self.specs.expert_names.index(name)
                self.adapter[i] = max(-1.4, min(1.4, self.adapter[i] + lr * d))
                self.pref[i] = max(0.25, min(2.8, self.pref[i] + 0.45 * lr * d))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Improved Planner (more diverse + higher quality)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class PlannerAgent:
    name = "planner"
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.moe = moe
        self.wm = wm
        self.specs = specs
        self.mcts = mcts
        self.rng = random.Random(99)

    def _base_plans(self, domain: Domain) -> List[Tuple[str, List[str]]]:
        if domain == Domain.CIVICS:
            return [
                ("Local-Resilience", ["inventory local capacity", "publish open decision log", "federate surplus", "run rupture drills", "verify reconstructability"]),
                ("Knowledge-Capsule", ["encode core science simply", "make redundant offline copies", "teach reconstruction ritual", "add verification checksums", "audit yearly"]),
                ("Hybrid-Core", ["map critical knowledge", "build local teaching nodes", "create physical + digital mirrors", "test recovery with strangers", "harden against single-point failure"]),
                ("Minimal-Viable", ["select 20 essential principles", "write in plain language", "store in 3 media types", "train 5 local teachers", "schedule quarterly recovery test"]),
            ]
        if domain == Domain.PLANNING:
            return [
                ("Staged-Reversible", ["map constraints", "pilot smallest reversible step", "measure impact", "scale or rollback", "document lessons"]),
                ("Portfolio", ["split into independent bets", "fund thinly", "kill losers fast", "double winners", "keep reserve"]),
            ]
        # generic fallback
        return [
            ("Clarify-Act", ["restate goal", "list hard constraints", "choose one high-leverage move", "define stop rule", "review"]),
            ("Search-Critique", ["generate 3 alternatives", "simulate each", "critique risks", "select best", "commit"]),
        ]

    def act(self, query: Query, ws: Workspace):
        ids = self.moe.route("plan " + query.text, query.domain, k=3,
                             skill_table=ws.skill_table, tool_graph=ws.tool_graph)
        moe_txt = self.moe.generate(query.text, ids)
        combo = [self.specs.expert_names[i] for i in ids]

        bases = self._base_plans(query.domain)
        # Add light mutations for diversity
        plans = []
        for i, (pid, steps) in enumerate(bases):
            plans.append((pid, steps))
            if self.rng.random() < 0.7:
                mut_steps = list(steps)
                mut_steps[-1] = mut_steps[-1] + self.rng.choice([" +verify", " +redundant", " +local-first"])
                plans.append((pid + "-v2", mut_steps))

        out = []
        for pid, steps in plans[:5]:  # max 5 candidates
            content = f"{pid}: {' → '.join(steps)}"
            out.append(ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.PLAN, content, refs=[pid],
                                       extra={"plan_id": pid, "actions": steps, "experts": combo})))
        return out

# Other Agents (simplified but solid)

class MemoryAgent:
    name = "memory"
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.moe = moe
    def act(self, query, ws):
        content = "Stored regularities:\n- Trust decays faster than infrastructure\n- Redundant local capacity survives central rupture\n- Simple verification beats complex security\n- Teach reconstruction, not just store knowledge"
        return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.MEMORY, content, score=0.75))]

class SimulatorAgent:
    name = "simulator"
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.wm = wm
        self.mcts = mcts
        self.specs = specs
    def act(self, query, ws):
        plans = [m for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if "actions" in m.extra]
        if not plans: return []
        start = self.wm.encode(query.text, query.domain)
        goal  = self.wm.encode("stable reconstructed knowledge + local capacity", query.domain)
        candidates = [(p.extra["plan_id"], p.extra["actions"]) for p in plans]
        best_pid, best_acts, best_q, stats = self.mcts.search(candidates, start, goal, self.specs.mcts_simulations)
        ws.notes["mcts"] = stats
        ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.MCTS, f"MCTS best = {best_pid} (Q={best_q:.3f})", score=best_q))
        out = []
        for p in plans:
            traj = self.wm.rollout(start, p.extra["actions"], goal, p.extra["plan_id"])
            out.append(ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.ROLLOUT,
                                       f"{p.extra['plan_id']}: {traj['summary']}",
                                       score=traj["terminal_value"],
                                       extra={"plan_id": p.extra["plan_id"],
                                              "value": traj["terminal_value"],
                                              "risk": traj["terminal_risk"]})))
        return out

class CriticAgent:
    name = "critic"
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.moe = moe
    def act(self, query, ws):
        rollouts = ws.of_kind(MsgKind.ROLLOUT)
        if not rollouts: return []
        best_val = max(r.extra.get("value", -1) for r in rollouts)
        out = []
        for r in rollouts:
            val = r.extra.get("value", 0.0)
            risk = r.extra.get("risk", 0.5)
            pid = r.extra.get("plan_id")
            stake_pen = {"low": 0.2, "medium": 0.35, "high": 0.5}[query.stakes.value]
            score = val - stake_pen * risk
            mcts = ws.notes.get("mcts", {})
            if pid in mcts:
                score += 0.18 * mcts[pid]["q"]
            veto = risk > 0.68 and query.stakes != Stakes.LOW
            reason = "VETO" if veto else ("strong" if score > 0.35 else "acceptable" if score > 0.15 else "weak")
            out.append(ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.CRITIQUE,
                                       f"{pid}: score={score:.2f} ({reason})",
                                       score=score,
                                       extra={"plan_id": pid, "veto": veto, "uncertainty": min(1.0, 0.35 + risk)})))
        return out

class TrainerAgent:
    name = "trainer"
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.moe = moe
    def act(self, query, ws):
        critiques = [m for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.CRITIQUE) if m.score is not None]
        if not critiques: return []
        live = [m for m in critiques if not m.extra.get("veto")]
        winner = max(live or critiques, key=lambda m: m.score or -9)
        deltas = defaultdict(float)
        win_plan = next((p for p in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if p.extra.get("plan_id") == winner.extra.get("plan_id")), None)
        if win_plan and "experts" in win_plan.extra:
            for e in win_plan.extra["experts"]:
                deltas[e] += (winner.score or 0) * 0.7
        for k, v in deltas.items():
            ws.skill_table[k] += 0.1 * v
        self.moe.apply_adapter_update(deltas)
        return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.TRAIN,
                                f"Winner={winner.extra.get('plan_id')} score={winner.score:.2f}",
                                score=winner.score))]

class SynthesizerAgent:
    name = "synthesizer"
    def __init__(self, moe, wm, specs, mcts):
        self.moe = moe
    def act(self, query, ws):
        critiques = [m for m in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.CRITIQUE) if m.score is not None]
        live = [m for m in critiques if not m.extra.get("veto")]
        winner = max(live or critiques, key=lambda m: m.score or -9) if (live or critiques) else None
        mem = ws.last(MsgKind.MEMORY)
        mcts_msg = ws.last(MsgKind.MCTS)
        if winner is None:
            body = "No plan survived critique."
            score = 0.0
            pid = None
            actions = []
        else:
            pid = winner.extra.get("plan_id")
            plan = next((p for p in ws.of_kind(MsgKind.PLAN) if p.extra.get("plan_id") == pid), None)
            actions = plan.extra.get("actions", []) if plan else []
            body = f"Selected: {pid}\nActions: {' → '.join(actions)}"
            score = float(winner.score or 0)
        # We will format the real report outside
        return [ws.post(Message(self.name, MsgKind.FINAL, body, score=score,
                                extra={"plan_id": pid, "actions": actions,
                                       "memory": mem.content if mem else "",
                                       "mcts": mcts_msg.content if mcts_msg else ""}))]

# Engine + Clean Report

@dataclass
class RunResult:
    answer: str
    score: float
    winner: Optional[str]
    actions: List[str]
    steps_used: int
    adapter: List[float]
    workspace: Workspace
    elapsed_s: float

class HybridAITrainer:
    def __init__(self, seed=7, verbose=False):
        self.specs = SystemSpecs()
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.moe = MixtureOfExperts(self.specs, self.rng)
        self.wm = TrainedGRUWorldModel(self.specs, seed=seed)
        self.mcts = MCTS(self.wm, self.specs, self.rng)
        self.verbose = verbose
        self.agents = {
            "memory": MemoryAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "planner": PlannerAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "simulator": SimulatorAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "critic": CriticAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "trainer": TrainerAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
            "synthesizer": SynthesizerAgent(self.moe, self.wm, self.specs, self.mcts),
        }

    def pretrain_wm(self, episodes=120):
        return self.wm.pretrain(n_episodes=episodes)

    def infer(self, text: str, domain: str = "civics", stakes: str = "high", train: bool = True) -> RunResult:
        q = Query(text=text, domain=Domain(domain), stakes=Stakes(stakes), train=train)
        ws = Workspace()
        t0 = time.time()

        if self.verbose: print("· memory")
        self.agents["memory"].act(q, ws)

        budget = 6 if stakes == "high" else 4
        for step in range(1, budget+1):
            if self.verbose: print(f"· iter {step}/{budget}")
            self.agents["planner"].act(q, ws)
            self.agents["simulator"].act(q, ws)
            critiques = self.agents["critic"].act(q, ws)
            best = max((m.score or -9 for m in critiques), default=-9)
            if best >= self.specs.consensus_tau:
                if self.verbose: print("· early stop (consensus)")
                break

        if train:
            self.agents["trainer"].act(q, ws)
        final_msg = self.agents["synthesizer"].act(q, ws)[-1]

        # -------- Clean Final Report --------
        report = textwrap.dedent(f"""
        ============================================================
        HYBRID AI TRAINER – FINAL REPORT
        ============================================================
        Query   : {text}
        Domain  : {domain.upper()} | Stakes: {stakes.upper()}
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECTED PLAN: {final_msg.extra.get('plan_id', 'None')}
        Score   : {final_msg.score:.3f}

        Actions:
        """)
        for i, act in enumerate(final_msg.extra.get("actions", []), 1):
            report += f"  {i}. {act}\n"

        report += textwrap.dedent(f"""
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        Why this plan won
        • MCTS       : {final_msg.extra.get('mcts', 'n/a')}
        • Critic     : highest non-vetoed score
        • Memory     : {final_msg.extra.get('memory', '').splitlines()[0] if final_msg.extra.get('memory') else 'n/a'}

        Adapter (learned expert preference):
        {self.moe.adapter}
        ============================================================
        """)

        return RunResult(
            answer=report,
            score=float(final_msg.score or 0),
            winner=final_msg.extra.get("plan_id"),
            actions=final_msg.extra.get("actions", []),
            steps_used=step,
            adapter=[round(x, 3) for x in self.moe.adapter],
            workspace=ws,
            elapsed_s=time.time() - t0,
        )

    print("Starting Hybrid AI Trainer v3.2 ...")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Hybrid AI Trainer v4.0
======================
Strongest 1-shot version:
- Stronger GRU World Model (better curriculum + value function)
- Higher-quality diverse Planner
- Clean professional report + plan comparison
- Stable MCTS + Adapter learning

from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, math, random, textwrap, time
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

VERSION = "4.0"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Types
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Domain(str, Enum):
    GENERAL = "general"
    PHYSICS = "physics"
    PLANNING = "planning"
    CIVICS = "civics"
    CODE = "code"

class Stakes(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"

class MsgKind(str, Enum):
    PLAN = "plan"
    ROLLOUT = "rollout"
    CRITIQUE = "critique"
    MEMORY = "memory"
    FINAL = "final"
    TRAIN = "train"
    LOG = "log"
    MCTS = "mcts"

@dataclass
class SystemSpecs:
    latent_dim: int = 16
    gru_hidden: int = 32
    max_horizon: int = 6
    mcts_simulations: int = 40
    consensus_tau: float = 0.58
    expert_names: Tuple[str, ...] = (
        "language", "knowledge", "formal", "physics",
        "planning", "critique", "memory", "synthesis",
    )

@dataclass
class Query:
    text: str
    domain: Domain = Domain.CIVICS
    stakes: Stakes = Stakes.HIGH
    train: bool = True

@dataclass
class LatentState:
    z: List[float]
    label: str = ""

@dataclass
class Message:
    sender: str
    kind: MsgKind
    content: str
    score: Optional[float] = None
    refs: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self):
        self.messages: List[Message] = []
        self.notes: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.skill_table: Dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
        self.tool_graph: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(float))
    def post(self, msg: Message) -> Message:
        self.messages.append(msg)
        return msg
    def of_kind(self, kind: MsgKind) -> List[Message]:
        return [m for m in self.messages if m.kind == kind]
    def last(self, kind: Optional[MsgKind] = None) -> Optional[Message]:
        seq = self.of_kind(kind) if kind else self.messages
        return seq[-1] if seq else None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stronger World Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _sigmoid(x: float) -> float:
    if x >= 0:
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x))
    ex = math.exp(x)
    return ex / (1.0 + ex)

class SimpleGRU:
    def __init__(self, input_dim: int, hidden_dim: int, seed: int = 42):
        self.input_dim = input_dim
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        scale = 0.10
        def mat(r, c):
            return [[rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(c)] for _ in range(r)]
        self.Wz = mat(hidden_dim, input_dim + hidden_dim)
        self.Wr = mat(hidden_dim, input_dim + hidden_dim)
        self.Wh = mat(hidden_dim, input_dim + hidden_dim)
        self.bz = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.br = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.bh = [0.0] * hidden_dim
        self.Wv = [rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.Wrsk = [rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(hidden_dim)]
        self.bv = 0.08
        self.brsk = -0.15

    def _mv(self, W, x):
        return [sum(W[i][j] * x[j] for j in range(len(x))) for i in range(len(W))]

    def step(self, x, h):
        inp = x + h
        z = [_sigmoid(s + self.bz[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._mv(self.Wz, inp))]
        r = [_sigmoid(s + self.br[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._mv(self.Wr, inp))]
        rh = [r[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)]
        ht = [math.tanh(s + self.bh[i]) for i, s in enumerate(self._mv(self.Wh, x + rh))]
        return [(1 - z[i]) * h[i] + z[i] * ht[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)]

    def value_risk(self, h):
        v = sum(self.Wv[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)) + self.bv
        r = sum(self.Wrsk[i] * h[i] for i in range(self.hidden_dim)) + self.brsk
        value = max(-1.0, min(1.0, math.tanh(v * 1.4)))
        risk  = max(0.04, min(0.92, _sigmoid(r * 1.25)))
        return value, risk

    def encode(self, vec):
        return self.step(vec, [0.0] * self.hidden_dim)

    def rollout(self, h0, actions_vec, horizon):
        h = list(h0)
        vals, risks = [], []
        for t in range(min(horizon, len(actions_vec))):
            h = self.step(actions_vec[t], h)
            v, r = self.value_risk(h)
            vals.append(v)
            risks.append(r)
        return vals, risks

    def train_step(self, seq, tv, tr, lr=0.016):
        h = [0.0] * self.hidden_dim
        hs = []
        for x in seq:
            h = self.step(x, h)
            hs.append(h[:])
        loss = 0.0
        for t, h in enumerate(hs):
            v, r = self.value_risk(h)
            dv, dr = v - tv[t], r - tr[t]
            loss += dv*dv + 1.4*dr*dr
            for i in range(self.hidden_dim):
                self.Wv[i]   -= lr * 2 * dv * h[i]
                self.Wrsk[i] -= lr * 2 * dr * h[i]
            self.bv   -= lr * 2 * dv
            self.brsk -= lr * 2 * dr
        return loss / max(1, len(hs))

def make_vec(text: str, dim: int) -> List[float]:
    d = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).digest()
    return [((d[i % len(d)] / 255.0) * 2 - 1) for i in range(dim)]

class WorldModel:
    def __init__(self, specs: SystemSpecs, seed: int = 7):
        self.specs = specs
        self.gru = SimpleGRU(specs.latent_dim, specs.gru_hidden, seed)
        self.rng = random.Random(seed + 13)

    def pretrain(self, episodes: int = 150):
        print(f"Pre-training strong World Model ({episodes} episodes)...")
        good = ["inventory", "replicate", "teach", "verify", "local", "redundant",
                "simple", "audit", "federate", "drill", "checksum", "mirror", "plain-language"]
        bad  = ["centralize", "complex", "single-point", "obscure", "hide", "overwrite"]
        losses = []
        for _ in range(episodes):
            acts, tv, tr = [], [], []
            for k in range(self.specs.max_horizon):
                if self.rng.random() < 0.68:
                    a = self.rng.choice(good) + f"-{k}"
                    tv.append(0.58 + self.rng.uniform(0, 0.28))
                    tr.append(0.12 + self.rng.uniform(0, 0.18))
                else:
                    a = self.rng.choice(bad) + f"-{k}"
                    tv.append(-0.25 + self.rng.uniform(-0.25, 0.05))
                    tr.append(0.58 + self.rng.uniform(0, 0.28))
                acts.append(a)
            seq = [make_vec("act:" + a, self.specs.latent_dim) for a in acts]
            losses.append(self.gru.train_step(seq, tv, tr, lr=0.017))
        print(f"Done. Final loss ≈ {losses[-1]:.4f}")
        return losses

    def encode(self, text: str, domain: Domain) -> LatentState:
        vec = make_vec(f"{domain.value}|{text}", self.specs.latent_dim)
        h = self.gru.encode(vec)
        z = (h + [0.0]*self.specs.latent_dim)[:self.specs.latent_dim]
        return LatentState(z=z, label=text[:40])

    def rollout(self, start: LatentState, actions: List[str], plan_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        h0 = (start.z + [0.0]*self.specs.gru_hidden)[:self.specs.gru_hidden]
        vecs = [make_vec("act:" + a, self.specs.latent_dim) for a in actions]
        vals, risks = self.gru.rollout(h0, vecs, self.specs.max_horizon)
        return {
            "plan_id": plan_id,
            "terminal_value": vals[-1] if vals else 0.0,
            "terminal_risk": risks[-1] if risks else 0.5,
            "summary": f"val={vals[-1] if vals else 0:.2f} risk={risks[-1] if risks else 0.5:.2f}",
            "vals": vals,
            "risks": risks,
        }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MCTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Node:
    def __init__(self, pid, acts, parent=None):
        self.pid = pid
        self.acts = acts
        self.parent = parent
        self.children = []
        self.N = 0
        self.W = 0.0
    @property
    def q(self):
        return self.W / self.N if self.N else 0.0
    def uct(self, c=1.45):
        if self.N == 0: return float("inf")
        pN = self.parent.N if self.parent else 1
        return self.q + c * math.sqrt(math.log(pN + 1) / self.N)

class MCTS:
    def __init__(self, wm: WorldModel, specs: SystemSpecs, rng: random.Random):
        self.wm = wm
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng

    def search(self, candidates: List[Tuple[str, List[str]]], start: LatentState, n_sim: int):
        roots = [Node(pid, acts) for pid, acts in candidates]
        if not roots:
            return None, [], 0.0, {}
        for _ in range(n_sim):
            node = max(roots, key=lambda n: n.uct())
            if node.N > 1 and len(node.children) < 3:
                new_acts = list(node.acts)
                mut = self.rng.choice([" +verify", " +redundant", " +local", " +teach", " +checksum"])
                new_acts[-1] = new_acts[-1] + mut
                child = Node(node.pid + f"v{len(node.children)}", new_acts, node)
                node.children.append(child)
                node = child
            traj = self.wm.rollout(start, node.acts, node.pid)
            value = traj["terminal_value"] - 0.42 * traj["terminal_risk"]
            while node:
                node.N += 1
                node.W += value
                node = node.parent
        best = max(roots, key=lambda n: n.q)
        stats = {r.pid: {"N": r.N, "Q": round(r.q, 3)} for r in roots}
        return best.pid, best.acts, best.q, stats

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MoE + Adapter
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class MoE:
    def __init__(self, specs: SystemSpecs, rng: random.Random):
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng
        self.load = [0] * len(specs.expert_names)
        self.pref = [1.0] * len(specs.expert_names)
        self.adapter = [0.0] * len(specs.expert_names)

    def route(self, text: str, domain: Domain, k: int = 3, skill=None):
        scores = [0.11 * self.pref[i] + self.adapter[i] for i in range(len(self.pref))]
        bias = {"civics": [1, 4, 5], "planning": [4, 2, 5], "physics": [3, 2, 5]}.get(domain.value, [0, 1, 7])
        for i in bias:
            scores[i] += 0.38
        low = text.lower()
        if any(w in low for w in ("knowledge", "archive", "science", "reconstruct")):
            scores[1] += 0.25
        if any(w in low for w in ("local", "capacity", "resilience", "community")):
            scores[4] += 0.25
        if any(w in low for w in ("risk", "fail", "verify", "robust")):
            scores[5] += 0.22
        if skill:
            for name, val in skill.items():
                if name in self.specs.expert_names:
                    scores[self.specs.expert_names.index(name)] += 0.14 * val
        scores = [s + 0.03 * self.rng.random() for s in scores]
        ranked = sorted(range(len(scores)), key=lambda i: -scores[i])
        chosen = ranked[:k]
        for i in chosen:
            self.load[i] += 1
        return chosen

    def apply_update(self, deltas: Dict[str, float], lr: float = 0.09):
        for name, d in deltas.items():
            if name in self.specs.expert_names:
                i = self.specs.expert_names.index(name)
                self.adapter[i] = max(-1.3, min(1.3, self.adapter[i] + lr * d))
                self.pref[i] = max(0.3, min(2.7, self.pref[i] + 0.4 * lr * d))

class Planner:
    def __init__(self, moe: MoE, specs: SystemSpecs, rng: random.Random):
        self.moe = moe
        self.specs = specs
        self.rng = rng

    def generate(self, query: Query, ws: Workspace) -> List[Message]:
        ids = self.moe.route(query.text, query.domain, k=3, skill=ws.skill_table)
        experts = [self.specs.expert_names[i] for i in ids]

        # High-quality plan library (studied patterns)
        library = [
            ("Local-First Resilience", [
                "inventory actual local capacity and skills",
                "publish open decision and knowledge log",
                "federate surplus resources and teachers",
                "run regular rupture and recovery drills",
                "verify that strangers can reconstruct core knowledge"
            ]),
            ("Redundant Knowledge Capsule", [
                "select 30 essential scientific principles in plain language",
                "create physical + digital + human-memory copies",
                "add simple checksum / verification method",
                "train multiple local teachers",
                "schedule and test full recovery yearly"
            ]),
            ("Hybrid Recovery System", [
                "map critical knowledge dependencies",
                "build small local teaching nodes",
                "maintain offline mirrors in 3 media",
                "practice recovery with people who never saw the material",
                "remove single points of failure"
            ]),
            ("Minimal Viable Archive", [
                "distill to the smallest robust core",
                "write so a 15-year-old can understand",
                "store in stone / metal / paper + digital",
                "embed recovery instructions in the archive itself",
                "test reconstruction under stress"
            ]),
            ("Community Science Seed", [
                "identify knowledge that enables more knowledge",
                "create teaching kits for core domains",
                "distribute kits to multiple independent groups",
                "establish simple inter-group verification",
                "evolve the kits through real recovery practice"
            ]),
        ]

        # Add intelligent mutations
        plans = []
        for name, steps in library:
            plans.append((name, steps))
            if self.rng.random() < 0.75:
                mut = list(steps)
                mut[-1] = mut[-1] + self.rng.choice([
                    " + explicit verification",
                    " + redundant teachers",
                    " + local materials only",
                    " + anti-fragility test"
                ])
                plans.append((name + " (enhanced)", mut))

        messages = []
        for i, (pid, acts) in enumerate(plans[:6]):
            msg = Message("planner", MsgKind.PLAN, f"{pid}",
                          refs=[pid],
                          extra={"plan_id": pid, "actions": acts, "experts": experts})
            messages.append(ws.post(msg))
        return messages

# Remaining Agents
